The table next to me asked, “Do you have any OO?” I saw this question asked a few times and it seemed cumbersome and uncomfortable. If there was a menu, I could have shown it to customers looking for other dishes, but since there wasn't one, I figured this store didn't have a menu and just walked around on the rail. This restaurant's style did not suit my taste, so I think people who like sushi and have similar tastes will be able to have a delicious meal.

I was debating whether to give it a 3 or a 4.

First of all, it's delicious. This is the best of the low-priced sushi restaurants.

But the problem here is that it is not cheap.

I know of two really delicious conveyor belt sushi restaurants that cost 1000~2000 and the taste is the same.

The taste is the same, but two flatfish sushi costs 5,000 won.

When I go to a sushi restaurant that I think is delicious, I try flounder first, and the flounder here is delicious too.

If I were to guess, flounder is better because the original itself is cheaper, and there is less burden of using slightly more expensive fish, so I think it is because the quality can be further improved. The price of other sushi rises just because of low-quality ingredients.

Anyway, it's really delicious, but it's a bit weird that the 5,000 won flounder sushi tastes the same as the 1,300 won or 1,900 won flatfish sushi in my neighborhood.

I understand because it's expensive in Yeouido, but the reviews say you have to wait in line to eat here, so there's no reason for that. Standing in line is a waste of money.

I happened to only use flounder, but the other sushi was all just delicious.

yes. They say that other sushi tastes the same as sushi restaurants that cost 1,000 won per plate.

But the price is more than double.

I also ordered 3 tuna and it was fun.

It was 10,000 won per plate, but Judo-ro and Akami were so expensive that I thought it was a waste of money.

However, the swordfish belly was so delicious that I thought it was omakase.

Next time I go, I will definitely have to order the swordfish belly.

The swordfish belly meat was superior to other low-priced sushi restaurants.

But the red tuna that came with it was very fishy... The other menu items tasted the same as those at sushi restaurants in the 1,000 won range.

To sum up, if you visit IFC Mall when there are no customers and want to eat some conveyor belt sushi, this is a place worth going to.

It's not that it doesn't taste good. The taste is the best among low-priced sushi restaurants. Of the dozens of low-cost sushi restaurants I've been to, this is one of the top five.

But the problem is that the best low-cost sushi restaurants in my neighborhood that I know of are two conveyor belt sushi restaurants and one pan sushi restaurant.

It's the same level as there.

The price is double.

I keep comparing it to cheap sushi restaurants, but considering the price, it's not even a cheap sushi restaurant.

Looking at the cheap plate, it tastes the same but costs twice as much.

Looking at it as an expensive 10,000 won plate, it is similar in price to a low-priced omakase lunch, but even if it is a low-priced omakase, the standard is very insignificant compared to omakase.

It's that kind of house.

Usually, a bad house is just bad, or a good house is just good.

What's a bit ambiguous about this place is that it's overly expensive and not particularly delicious, so there's a lot to say about it.

It's absolutely not worth waiting in line or looking for.

reviews.author: Namaste
reviews.text:
🏢 Atmosphere and interior
• Modern, understated and minimalistic interior.
The ceiling is open, giving an industrial feel, while traditional Japanese lighting (round lights, wave patterns, etc.) here and there harmonizes well.
• The entire store feels spacious and bright thanks to the glass partition and neat lighting.
• An open kitchen where you can immediately see the chef cooking, and the flow path between the kitchen and customer seats is also stable.
• The tablet ordering system installed at each table enables non-face-to-face ordering, making it convenient.

🍽️Food composition and taste

1. Basic side dishes
• Rakkyo and pickled ginger are neatly served on small plates.
• Water and tea are provided in paper cups, and cutlery is neatly prepared.

2. Appetizer
• Steamed Egg Jjim: With shrimp on top, it has both rich flavor and texture.
• Salmon salad: A refreshing dressing, fresh vegetables, and salmon go well together.
• Croquette: Crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, like potato cream.
• Eel dish: Small but impactful, sweet soy sauce-based dish that is satisfying even without rice.

3. Sushi
• 7 types of assorted sushi provided
Composition: A diverse and balanced composition including salmon, tuna, white fish, sweet shrimp, and eel.
• The sushi rice grains are seasoned appropriately and the freshness of the ingredients is satisfactory.

4. Cooking soup
• Soybean paste soup: A savory, non-salty taste that serves as a great ending to the entire meal.

5. Dessert
• Mini dessert plate consisting of pineapple, green grapes, and coffee jelly.
• The composition is impressive and allows for a refreshing finish without burden.

💬 Overall Review
• Cost-effective: It consists of appetizers, sushi, and dessert in one course, making it suitable for lunch or a casual entertaining meal.
• Service: Staff response is friendly and fast, and tables are cleaned regularly.
• Intention to revisit: Yes. A reliable choice if you are looking for quiet and neat Japanese food near Yeouido.

A restaurant specializing in ramen
Located in the restaurant area on the first basement floor of Manhattan Building (formerly Yeouido Department Store), a 5-minute walk from Exit 5 of Yeouido Station.
Shoyu ramen is 13,000 won, and rice bowl is 1,000 won.

The soup is amazing~
The highlight is the rich soup, and although it is called chicken broth, it has almost no chicken flavor.
Perhaps because it is seasoned with soy sauce, it feels similar to udon soup.
Of course, the soup is so thick that I tend to keep using my spoon.
The noodles have a slightly textured style, so you may have your own preferences!
Toppings include chashu, eggs, and seaweed, and the eggs are Japanese-style ajitamago~
The texture and taste weren't bad and I liked it.
The chashu is pretty good, and it would be a shame to not have it.
The phrase ‘fragrant rice made with the highest quality rice’ on the menu caught people’s attention, so bowl rice was added as well~
The rice is just plain rice, but it seems to be the most delicious when dipped in tonkotsu soup.
As a side dish, you can eat kimchi and pickled radish together from the self-service bar.

Store & Tips & Review
The store is not large, but there are quite a few tables.
It has counter seating and table seating, so eating alone is also OK.
You order at the table and pay at the counter when you go.
The menu consists of several types of ramen, side menus, and snacks.
Alcohol is also sold in the evening as an izakaya.
Of course, eating only ramen is no problem at all.
Perhaps that's why the atmosphere of the store feels a bit like a bar.
I visited at 7pm on a weekday, and the store was quite busy.

reviews.text:
Mayuyu Malatang is a malatang restaurant well known for its special and rich malatang.
It is located in the restaurant area on the basement level of The Hyundai Seoul, which I visited, and although the sign is a bit small, it is easy to find just by the red soup in the bowl and the spicy smell.
The Hyundai Seoul branch we visited was already full even though it was 3pm on a weekend Saturday, so after waiting for a while, we took a seat and went out to order.

This is the Mayuyu Malatang menu.
I liked the harmony of the main dishes and side dishes such as beef malatang, mala xiangguo, and beef pork stew noodle, so I wanted to try them all.
To order, first place the vegetables and toppings displayed at the stand in a transparent bowl.

There were many kinds of mushrooms, fish cakes, sausages, corn noodles, bean sprouts, cabbage, rice cakes, etc., and most of all, it was nice that they were kept fresh.
All you have to do is fill up a bowl, go to the counter, and place your order.
We were craving spicy malatang, so we ordered beef malatang and glutinous rice cake.
You can adjust the spiciness level, but I chose level 1, which is about the level of spiciness of Shin Ramyun, which is the ramen I usually eat.

Because there were so many people, the food came out about 15 minutes after ordering.
You must show the number tag you received when ordering at the pick-up counter and bring it directly to your seat.
The malatang, with its spicy scent and spicy appearance, looked very appetizing.
All of the toppings I included were included well, and they were evenly cooked.
Normally, I have never eaten rice with malatang, but I tried the Mayuyu malatang here because it is sold as a set with air rice.
But the flavors went together so well that my eyes lit up!

The glutinous rice kkuvarou that I ordered as a side menu was cooked to the perfect texture.
The thickness of the fries was just right and the pork inside was cooked well, so I ate it deliciously without any unpleasant smell.
I was disappointed that the portion was a bit small, but the sauce tasted light and was good.
You can put all used dishes in the bin.

Mayuyu Malatang, where you can eat well-organized and delicious malatang at The Hyundai Seoul.
The freshness of the vegetables and toppings were good, and the tangy and spicy flavor of the soup made my stress melt away!
Personally, I think I will visit again if I feel like eating malatang at The Hyundai Seoul~

Saturday evening in December 2025

[Went to eat Kkoobaro and found top-notch yukjjamppong]

I went to taste Kwao Baro, which was recommended by an acquaintance, and was impressed by the unexpectedly top-notch yuk jjamppong.

** Onion butter on the outside and inside
The meat is soft, the seasoning is moderately spicy, and the soft and savory flavor of the butter is the attractive point.

**Top-class Octopus Abalone Jjamppong
In fact, the twist of this visit was this Jjambbong. It was a menu item that I wanted to serve with a spicy meal because I thought it would be greasy, but as soon as I took a bite, my eyes lit up.

# Perfect fiery taste: The fiery scent was not overpowering and was just pleasant enough.
# Heavy broth: In addition to the octopus and abalone toppings, the meat-based, heavy and rich broth is excellent.
# Balance of savory and spicy: It's moderately spicy and has a savory flavor at the end that makes me keep eating the soup because it's so attractive.
# Kick! Always add rice
Since you can only truly appreciate delicious Jjamppong when you eat it with rice, I ordered steamed rice. The moment when the slightly dry grains of rice soak in the rich soup, and the starch in the rice melts into the soup, doubling the flavor! It was the best taste, on par with other Jjambbong restaurants across the country.

reviews.text:
I went to Shinhong Tower in Yeouido! 🥢✨ Overall, it was a very luxurious and satisfying experience as I was able to enjoy delicious Chinese food. Recommended for those who like colorful cuisine and atmosphere! 😊

First, I ordered Peking duck the day before. 🦆✨The crispy grilled skin and soft duck meat wrapped in wheat pancakes tasted fantastic. 🥒🧄 When I ate it with cucumbers, green onions, and sweet sauce, I was able to feel the deep flavor of the savory and sweet combination in my mouth.

Next, I ordered red pepper japchae. 🌶️🥩 The spicy yet savory taste of various vegetables and beef combined was truly exquisite. The moderate spiciness of the peppers and the soft texture of the beef went well together💛

I was also impressed by the fried eggplant served with truffle sauce. 🍆🍄 I was able to enjoy a luxurious taste with the truffle sauce added to the crispy fried eggplant. The truffle flavor blended well with the nutty flavor of the eggplant, making it unique and delicious. It was nice that it came with a variety of mushrooms, giving it a variety of textures.

The inside of the restaurant was decorated with a luxurious interior, making it a great atmosphere to visit on a special day. 🏮 The lighting was soft and the space between tables was wide, so I was able to eat comfortably. The staff were very friendly and attentive, so I was able to spend the entire meal comfortably. 😊

The price may be a bit high, but considering the quality of the food and the overall experience, I felt it was well worth it. 💸 I recommend Xinhong Lou to those who want to enjoy luxurious Chinese food with their loved ones on a special day! I want to try more other dishes next time. 🍜✨

If you want some special Chinese food in Yeouido, visit Shinhong Lou. I was really satisfied with the Peking duck and red pepper japchae, and the added atmosphere made it a perfect dinner! 💯

Paldang Banjeom is unique in that it has three stores in Yeouido alone. Unlike other branches, this branch seems to have some issues with the quality of the food. I ordered beef rice noodles and pineapple fried rice. The rice noodles had a strong taste of spices that I didn't normally eat, so I liked them because I felt like I was eating them in some part of Vietnam. The pineapple fried rice was delicious in its own way because various spices and bean sprouts were added to the fried rice.

At first, I was surprised by the taste that I had never tried before at an existing Vietnamese pho chain, but as I ate it, I got used to it and would like to visit and order it again at least once.

One of the best pho restaurants in Yeouido! Of all the chains, I think this one is the best.

I use this place occasionally for lunch, but the atmosphere is quiet and the food is decent and good.

If you are using it for the first time, you may not be able to get used to it, but it is a place where you can eat quietly (where it is recommended to talk quietly so as not to be heard by the people next to you).

This is a bar table where all tables face the kitchen.

Food is ordered through a kiosk, so you can pre-order before entering.

For parking, you can use the shopping mall parking lot, but since it is an older shopping mall than you might think, there may be some issues with using it.

reviews.author: sh m
reviews.text:
We entered after waiting for about 20 minutes during lunch hour. Please note that if you order at the kiosk in advance and insert your receipt, you will be admitted in order.

I visited on the recommendation of a co-worker, but they said it was a place where you shouldn't make noise, so I had to keep the conversation simple. If you feel like your voice gets louder, they go and warn you.

Noodles and bean sprouts are refilled for free, and cilantro is also provided if you ask! Just sprinkle the sauce in front of you.
My first impression of the soup before adding the cilantro... It felt like a beef soup soup... It didn't feel like rice noodles, huh? But because I added cilantro, it started to look like rice noodles.

Those who like Korean-style pho will likely really like the pho here, but those who like Vietnamese-style pho will likely be disappointed. I was a little disappointed!

However, I was satisfied with having a proper lunch in Yeouido, so I would like to visit again.

reviews.text:
This is a branch of Sinchon Mibundang, located on the 2nd floor of the Yeouido Duke Apartment shopping complex. It's a Vietnamese-style pho restaurant, but the interior and atmosphere have a slightly Japanese feel.

I arrived around 11:30 and waited for about 30 minutes. When you purchase a menu item from the vending machine at the entrance of the store, you will be given a number. Just enter when your number is called.

Conversation is strictly prohibited indoors, so I think it would be good for those who eat alone. On the other hand, there is only bar seating, so I wouldn't recommend it for more than 3 people.

The food was clean and delicious. In particular, there is an event where they give you buffalo wings when you order two bottles of beer, and the buffalo wings are really delicious. Personally, it was better than most pizza places.

# Menu: Poo Pad Bon Curry 36,000, Saint Augustine Noodle 18,000, Coconut Tamarin Chicken 16,000

You can make a reservation, but since it was a weekday, I just went, and it seemed like window seats were given in the order of reservations. However, I was assigned a comfortable seat inside.

The portion sizes for each menu were not small, and the chicken served on the side was delicious. The menu items were all greasy, so I felt like I couldn't do it without soda haha.

reviews.author: Genius Kim
reviews.text:
Just as my wife was desperately craving Saint-Augustin, Timon sold a 40% discount meal coupon just before Chuseok, so she used it as a meal coupon.

I ate som tam, king prawn pad thai, and pupat bong curry (crab) at the store, and I got packaged pupat bong curry (shrimp) and nasi goreng for 123,000 won.

The two of us ordered over 100,000 won. It was an incredibly flexible day for a commoner like me.

1. Store waiting
At the Yeouido branch, office workers flock to the restaurant like zombies during their lunch hour, so the standard wait time is over 20 minutes, but today I went in right away.
I don't know if Saint-Augustin's popularity has waned these days, but from a customer's perspective, it's nice to not have to wait.

2. Food
Somtam is a vegetable salad filled with plenty of sour sauce.
It's a scent and taste of a sauce I've never tried before, but there's little resistance to it.
However, it was disappointing that the quantity was so small even though it was priced at 17,000 won.

Pupodbon curry was the best menu item and had a very good unique curry aroma and taste.
It goes very well with whole fried crab.
It was perfect with the addition of rice.

There is only one king prawn in the king prawn pad thai, so it is good for my wife.
It has a slightly spicy taste that is just right for spicy eaters like me.
The combination of bean sprouts and noodles is good.
My wife and I both said that it was disappointing that the amount was too small.

3. Atmosphere
It wasn't crowded for a weekday lunch, so it was nice to eat there.
You can order from the menu using the tablets installed at each table.
There is a call bell at each table, making it easy to call staff.

Overall, except that the portion size was small compared to the price, I was satisfied with the atmosphere and taste.

Please note that even if it is not a 40% discount coupon, there are often discount events, so if you plan well for the events, you can eat at a slightly cheaper price.

The price is too expensive compared to the food. I visited the main branch in Mangwon-dong after hearing about its popularity, but the price and above all, it was too long. I topped the potatoes with salt, sugar, garlic sauce, and cheese, but the garlic jam didn't go well with it, and more than anything, the chunks of salt were chewy and it was too salty. Even the raw noodles are picked up with bare hands and put into the pot, and the cooking is done with bare hands throughout the process. Even if it is possible because he is the person in charge of cooking, the person doing the calculation next to him is not only in front of the calculator, but he also adds cheese powder to the cooked pasta and toppings to the french fries. He also grabs and grates the cheese with his bare hands and sprinkles the toppings on by hand. I know it's busy, but I think it would be a good idea to increase the number of people and appoint people in charge or wear gloves. No basic tissues. It's because we went at 12 o'clock, but the food came out really late even though it was a weekday. I wasn't expecting much, but it was a disappointing lunch.

reviews.text:
The atmosphere is acceptable. It's a restaurant, but it's very frustrating that you have to order using a QR code. The pizza passed, including the dough. Everything else is really disappointing. Focaccia tastes like nothing. It's like a dinner roll (morning bread) with low gluten content and a sweet taste. It does not go well with olive oil and balsamic for dipping. The pasta was too sweet and didn't have an Italian feel, and when I passed the shaving tables, I saw a hint of overcooking, so I thought it couldn't be true, but it was Kotura-level overcooking. I thought it was a vegetarian version of Neapolitan pasta... . The batter for the fries was thin, so it was good that it brought out the taste of the ingredients, but it seemed like the smell of seafood and soybean oil was stuck in the oil. reviews.author: Namaste
reviews.text:
The exterior is open with glass, and on nice days, the outside terrace seats are open, so it felt like the perfect place to “eat while enjoying the fresh air for lunch.”

When you go inside, the industrial mood that utilizes the ceiling pipes and the round ball lights create a warm atmosphere, making it more of a casual but slightly stylish brunch/dining experience.

Atmosphere/Seating
- The window seat has good lighting, so it goes well with Yeouido’s unique city view.
- The table setting (plates/water glasses) is also neat, so it's suitable for a blind date or light meeting.
- The terrace is definitely an advantage as long as the weather cooperates (satisfaction increases on sunny days)

Menu composition/price range experience
Looking at the menu, the lineup is quite wide, focusing on pasta/rice bowls/salad/pizza, and there is also beer (draft), highball, house wine, and dessert, making it a good place to have a meal and a drink.

Compared to Yeouido standards, the prices are generally average to slightly above average (late 10,000 won to low 20,000 won for lunch/main).

Taste (based on the menu eaten)

Pasta style is rose/tomato cream base with meatballs: I tend to go with a steady diet without any likes or dislikes.
- The sauce gently coats the noodles.
- Arugula and cheese go on top to reduce the greasiness.
- Since it contains meatballs, it is quite filling even as a single dish.

Rather than an impact like “Wow, I’ll definitely visit this place again,” it’s more of a “not bad” experience with a solid foundation. It felt like an option with a low probability of failure.

Recommended for days like this
- When looking for a nice lunch/lunch in Yeouido
- When you have different tastes for pasta/rice bowl/pizza but need to get it all in one place
- When going to a place with a glass of wine (draft/highball/wine)

Overall Review: Yeouido lunch/casual dining with a pretty space, wide menu, and consistently good taste.

Review of visit to TraGa in Yeouido 🥘🍤🍷

I had a special evening at **TraGa**, a Spanish food restaurant in Yeouido. This is a place where you can experience the essence of Spanish cuisine, and each and every dish was made with great care. 🇪🇸✨

1. Food

🍤 Gambas al Ajillo

These gambas, made with shrimp and garlic stir-fried in olive oil, did not disappoint! The shrimp were plump and had a soft taste with the scent of garlic and oil blending well together. A fantastic combination when eaten with bread! 🥖✨

🍆 Grilled vegetable platter

There were plenty of vegetables, including grilled eggplant, tomatoes, and mushrooms, so it had a healthy yet savory taste. I really liked the combination of olive oil and herbs. 🥗

🐔 Chicken Paella (Pollo Paella)

Paella, Spain's representative dish! The chicken was soft and each grain of rice was cooked just right and the flavor was well absorbed. I really felt like I was eating in Spain. 🍋

🍝 Tomato Sauce Egg Bake

The eggs and cheese melted in the rich tomato sauce were really soft and had a rich flavor. Recommended if you like a soft texture like cream pasta! 🧀

2. Atmosphere

The interior, filled with warm lighting, gave a sophisticated yet cozy feeling. It was the perfect place to chat with friends over a glass of wine. 🍷🍴

3. Price

reviews.author: JeongHyoJin
reviews.text:
I wonder if there is another restaurant with such reasonable prices.
I visited faraway Yeouido after work for the first time in a long time.
I made a reservation and visited Leboeuf to celebrate my anniversary.

It is close to Exit 5 of Yeouido Station, so accessibility is good.
However, I wondered if this was the building since it was on the 3rd floor of an old commercial building.
When the elevator arrived at the 3rd floor of the shopping center, I looked around to see where it was, but I could see the quiet entrance of Woodton alone in the distance, so I was able to find it easily.

When I visited the store, clerks in suits greeted me kindly.
Since I looked at the wine list in advance and selected it, I ordered wine right away.
Steak garnishes are not provided separately, so you have to order individual dishes, but I chose artichoke, which I was personally unfamiliar with.

The price for a single course is reasonable at 33,000 won, but the wine is a bit more expensive.
The price of the wines I often saw at the supermarket came to mind, so I carefully chose 'Simal Garnacha'.
It was heavy yet had a strong acidity, making it good to eat with food.

First, toasted bread and fig butter are provided.
The brioche is served warm and the fig butter is subtle and delicious.

Next, the octopus boppo is served, and the octopus cooked at low temperature is so soft and delicious.
Often when I order octopus dish, it is often dry, but it was very soft and had a fiery taste, so I was most satisfied with it.
Capers, baked potatoes, and a sauce made of parsley or herbs were on the bottom, and it was so delicious to eat them together.

The next menu item was a dish called terrine, and it was salty, so it was good to eat with wine.
Terrine is a dish made by coarsely grinding meat and hardening it like jelly, and it tastes similar to sausage or donggeurangttaeng.

Next were separately ordered artichokes and steak.
Artichoke is a vegetable I have never seen before. It is an unusual dish that is cooked sour but not crunchy.
It would have been better if it had a different texture, but it was sour and good to eat with fatty foods.

You are given the option to eat the steak with gravy or dip it in.
It was cooked properly, seasoned just right, and delicious.
It is also delicious eaten with fig butter and whole grain mustard from other menu items in the course.

My stomach was already full, so the next menu item was lasagna.
I was full, but the lasagna was so delicious that I went back in again.
A taste that makes you want to eat lasagna alone.

To finish, I had cognac ice cream. I couldn't really taste the cognac, but it was sweet and delicious.
I left the store with my stomach full.
I had a good time.

It's strange that Koreans are willing to spend so much money on something so ordinary. But everyone has different tastes.

reviews.author: Son Joo-il (Cecil)
reviews.text:
The Wind at The Hyundai Seoul, Alice Dalton Brown Retrospective Exhibition Review
With the weather being so sweltering like these days, I often feel like I want to go somewhere. At such times, what if there was an exhibition that would take you to a place where the cool breeze blows, forgetting your daily life for a moment? Alice Dalton Brown's retrospective exhibition, 《In a Moment, Forever》, held at The Hyundai Seoul ALT.1 in Yeouido, was a place that presented such a pleasant rest.

The first thing that greets us upon entering the exhibition hall is her iconic ‘Curtain and Sea’ series. When I actually encountered a painting that I had only seen in photos or videos, the emotion was beyond my imagination. The blue sea glistening beyond the thin curtain and the sunlight pouring down on it made me feel like I was seeing a real landscape before my eyes. Just standing still in front of the painting made me feel at peace as I felt a cool sea breeze blowing from somewhere.

However, the reason why this retrospective was even more special was because we were able to see the representative image that comes to mind when we think of ‘Alice Dalton Brown’ and the diverse world of her works beyond that.

I was particularly impressed by the early works, which had a different charm from the tranquil seascapes. The crude but powerful barn drawings and oil paintings expressed in warm colors gave us a glimpse into how she established her own style and the beginning of her artistic journey.

Additionally, her architectural paintings using light and shadow once again demonstrated her reputation as a ‘painter of light.’ The work, which depicts a white building reminiscent of an alley in Greece and dark shadows cast over a spiral staircase, made me feel the intense sunlight and the silence within at the same time. Meanwhile, on a dark evening, the painting that captured the light from the chandelier leaking from inside the house created a warm yet somehow mysterious atmosphere that made me stay for a long time.

The exhibition does not stop at simply listing beautiful paintings, but also shows in three dimensions how an artist has explored light, shadow, wind, and space throughout his life and expressed it in his own language. It was a valuable opportunity to see her wide spectrum, from abstract works expressing interior landscapes with bold color fields to hyper-realistic sea paintings.

Although the exhibition was held in a department store in a busy city, the power of Alice Dalton Brown's paintings made us forget all the noise, even if only for a moment. It was such a magical moment that I wanted to walk into the painting and take a break.

If you need a break during the hot summer, how about an art vacation at The Hyundai Seoul? The pleasant breeze captured on canvas by Alice Dalton Brown will bring a little comfort and vitality to your daily life. The exhibition is said to continue until September 20th, so I recommend you visit before it's too late.

A day of enjoyment for both the eyes and the mouth, The Hyundai Seoul ‘Bun Patty Bun’
After seeing a good exhibition, my heart feels full, but I guess I can't help but feel hungry. Full of emotion from the Alice Dalton Brown exhibition, I headed to Bun Patty Bun, a handmade burger located next to the escalator to The Hyundai Seoul Central Garden. I saw it on my way to the Alice Dalton Brown retrospective, and the interior and cleanliness caught my eye.
The confident phrase, “This is a real burger!” and the appetizing buns on the display stand made me stop in my tracks. I also liked the modern and clean interior. The pride in quality ingredients, such as organic flour, 100% beef patties, and fresh vegetables, was written on the wall, raising expectations for the food even more.
The menu I ordered was the signature menu with the same name as the store, **'Bun Patty Bun Burger' (10,800 won)**. The burger I received after waiting for a while was truly a ‘perfect sight’.
Thick beef patty, melted cheese, crispy grilled bacon, and fresh tomatoes and lettuce between shiny brioche buns. It was a mouth-watering combination just looking at it.
The moment I took a big bite, I immediately knew why the store was called ‘Bun Patty Bun’. First of all, the bun was truly a work of art. The bun, which was said to be made with organic flour, was very soft and moist without being dry, and was full of a nutty buttery flavor. Needless to say, the 100% beef patty was filled with juicy meat. The combination of fresh vegetables, which can easily be overwhelming, is perfect, creating a perfect balance right down to the last bite.
I really felt like I was eating the ‘quintessential delicious burger’. If the good exhibition was a feast for the eyes, the delicious burger made my mouth happy as well, making it a perfect way to end the day.
If you want a hearty and delicious meal after enjoying shopping or exhibitions at The Hyundai Seoul, I highly recommend ‘Bun Patty Bun’. You will be able to taste a truly satisfying handmade burger that is faithful to the basics yet has a deep flavor!

reviews.text:
I usually only eat Shanghai Spicy Burgers, but I couldn't help but be curious about the new Double Shanghai Spicy Burger.
From the first bite, the temperature of the chicken patty was surprising. The meat was hot and juicy inside the crispy exterior, giving it not just ‘warm’ but ‘fresh heat as if it had just been fried.’
Because there are two patties, the rich texture and spiciness are doubled, and the overall perfection is high.

My friend who was with me said that the amount of sauce was a bit lacking, but personally, it was just the right balance.
The fries were still perfect, and it was a shame that there was no carbonated refill.
If the rumor that ‘there is a location where cola refills are available’ is true, I think it would be nice if it were introduced here as well.

In conclusion, it was a new menu item from McDonald's that gave me more satisfaction than expected after a long time.

reviews.author: Jason Ham
reviews.text:
IFCmall L3 Restaurant One is located at the very end of the IFC area. Because it is the only public fast food restaurant not only in IFC Mall but also in the surrounding area, there is a significant number of visitors during lunch time. No, it's huge. From personal experience, I can confidently say that the number of visitors during peak lunch hours is among the top 3 stores in Seoul.

However, McDonald's Yeouido branch chose to compete head-on with the flock of visitors. During the remodeling, the table space was reduced and the kitchen space was expanded. And orders are accepted through six kiosks, which are unprecedented. As of 12:10 on weekdays, there is a waiting line behind 6 kiosks, and my number is pushed back and does not appear on the monitor that shows order numbers. Of course, it's a struggle to get a table, but fortunately, most visitors half-willingly choose take-out.

There is a huge influx of orders during peak lunch hours, but as the staff working during those hours are concentrated and each person performs their role perfectly, the large number of orders gradually decreases, and there is some leeway after 14:00, when the mac lunch ends.

There are so few visitors during evening hours that it is embarrassing to call it ‘peak’. The tables are always empty and you can enjoy a leisurely meal.

In large shopping malls, McDonald's is often chosen as the next best option when the wait at a popular store is too long, but at the Yeouido branch McDonald's, on the other hand, many people are surprised by the McDonald's waiting number and return to the IFC Mall food court, so please keep in mind.

reviews.author: Mihee Han
reviews.text:
I visited this place while looking for a good hamburger restaurant near Yeouido Station. In conclusion, I intend to visit again 👍

I ordered the Crispy Chicken Set and Shrimp Deluxe, and I was satisfied with both.
The chicken burger was crispy on the outside and moist on the inside, so the texture was really good, and the seasoning was just right. The buns were soft and the overall balance was good.

Shrimp Deluxe has a plump and springy shrimp patty, so I recommend it to people who like shrimp. It had a clean, non-greasy taste, so it was easy to eat without feeling burdened.

Another advantage is that you can get unlimited refills of soda if you order a set, and the self-service bar management was also neat. Even though I went in the evening, I saw a steady stream of customers coming in, so it seemed like it was already a popular place in Yeouido.

Recommended when you want to eat a homemade burger at a reasonable price at Yeouido Station 🍔✨
